description: Everything for images: check quota (limits), get sizing guidance (guide), host an external image URL (upload_url), upload a local file as base64 (upload_file), or AI-generate an image with Gemini (generate). guide/generate accept a section (logo, favicon, hero, feature, product, gallery, blog, background) so results are sized for the slot — call action="guide" first when unsure. generate: be specific about subject, style, background and framing; pass referenceImageUrls (up to 4, e.g. the current logo or a product photo) to keep brand/style consistent or edit an image. upload_file validates size (max 20 MB), dimensions (min 200×200px) and type (JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF), auto-converting to WebP. Returned URLs are ready for products and blocks.

base64.description: upload_file: the image encoded as base64 (with or without the data: prefix)

mimeType.description: upload_file: MIME type hint, e.g. "image/jpeg" (auto-detected if omitted)

projectId.description: Optional website project ID so media is filed under that site's folder

prompt.description: generate: what to create — use the promptRecipe from action="guide"

referenceImageUrls.description: generate: up to 4 public image URLs to guide style or edit

url.description: upload_url: public http(s) URL of the image to host

name: manage_media
